find_routes.description: Find KMB and Long Win bus routes by route number, or by a place they start or end at in English or Chinese, such as Star Ferry or 尖沙咀. Each comes once for each direction, with where it starts and ends in English, Traditional and Simplified Chinese.
find_routes.name: find_routes

parameters.description: A route number, such as 1A, or words in the name of a place a route starts or ends at. Leave empty for every route.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Also list each route's special departures, which start, end or call somewhere different from its normal service.
parameters.name: include_special

query.description: The route number or place that was searched for.

routes.description: The routes found, in route number order.

items.description: A route, one way, one service.

circular.description: True for a circular route, which ends where it starts.

destination_en.description: Where the route ends in English.

destination_sc.description: Where the route ends in Simplified Chinese.

destination_tc.description: Where the route ends in Traditional Chinese.

direction.description: outbound (from the origin to the destination) or inbound (the way back).

origin_en.description: Where the route starts in English.

origin_sc.description: Where the route starts in Simplified Chinese.

origin_tc.description: Where the route starts in Traditional Chinese.

route.description: The route number, such as 1A or A41.

service_type.description: 1 for the route's normal service; 2 and up for its special departures, which start, end or call somewhere different.

special.description: True for a special departure (service type 2 and up).

find_stops.description: Find KMB bus stops whose name has every word you type, in English or Chinese, exact names first, each with its ID, coordinates and the routes that call there. Optionally only stops on one route.

description: Get real-time arrivals for KMB and Long Win buses in Hong Kong from their open data: the next buses at any stop with minutes to go, routes and their stops in order, stops by name or nearest a point, and the routes at each stop, in English and Chinese. Start a workflow when your bus is a few minutes away. No account or API key required.

kmb_bus_due_trigger.description: Runs once for each bus on a KMB route as it comes within a few minutes of a stop, with its time, minutes to go and destination. Buses already that close when the workflow is turned on don't run it.
kmb_bus_due_trigger.display_name: KMB bus due at a stop

output.destination_en: Where the bus is going, in English.
output.destination_sc: Where the bus is going, in Simplified Chinese.
output.destination_tc: Where the bus is going, in Traditional Chinese.
output.eta: When the bus is expected, as an ISO 8601 time in Hong Kong time.
output.eta_time: The same time as a Hong Kong clock time, such as 09:15.
output.minutes: Whole minutes until the bus is expected; 0 when it is due now.
output.order: 1 when it is the next bus, 2 for the one after, 3 for the third.
output.remark_en: KMB's remark on this bus in English, such as Scheduled Bus.
output.scheduled: True when the time comes from the timetable (the bus has not set off or is not tracked yet); false when it comes from the bus's position.
output.stop_name_sc: The stop's name in Simplified Chinese.
output.stop_name_tc: The stop's name in Traditional Chinese.
output.within_minutes: The minutes the workflow was set to watch for.

parameters.description: The route to watch, such as 1A.
parameters.name: route

parameters.description: Which way the bus is going, named by where it goes.
parameters.name: direction

parameters.description: The stop to watch, from the route's stops in order.
parameters.name: stop

parameters.description: How many minutes away a bus is when the workflow runs. Leave blank for 10 minutes. On a plan that checks every 15 minutes, choose 15 or more so no bus is missed.
parameters.name: within_minutes
